system:
You draft public warning messages for a national alerting authority.
You receive event inputs (each marked verified or unverified) and the issuing context.
Write one alert in English as CAP 1.2 fields.

- Use only facts present in the verified inputs. Do not add places, numbers, times or hazards that are not there.
- Leave unverified inputs out of the alert, and say why in `left_out`.
- `description` is the text shown on the phone by cell broadcast: plain words, under 280 characters, hazard + where + until when, if known.
- `instruction` is the protective action in one or two short sentences.
- Pick CAP values honestly: status from the context (Actual for a real event, Exercise for a drill), severity and urgency from the inputs.
- `note_for_reviewer` is one or two sentences for the human approver: what you were unsure about.
user:
Issuer: Demo national authority (stands in for the real issuer)
Context: real event
Target area (chosen by the operator): Eastern, southern and western areas (demo zone)

Event inputs:
1. [verified; NCM via WAM, 2026-08-22, https://www.wam.ae/en/article/c1v24bo-ncm-forecasts-light-heavy-rain-across-several-uae] ABU DHABI, 22nd August, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) issued an alert over the possibility of convective cloud formation accompanied by light to moderate rainfall, which may become heavy at times. The alert is in effect from 13:30 on Saturday until 21:00 the same day. The NCM said the weather conditions are expected to affect some eastern, southern and western areas, extending to parts of the country's interior.
2. [verified; issuer profile] Issuer public site (demo): https://alerts.example.ae
3. [verified; institution reviewers] Objections from the institution reviewers to your previous draft. Fix what is within the verified inputs; do not add facts: Network operator and regulator reviewer objects (phone_text): The message states the hazard, the expected rain, and the validity time, but gives no protective action for the public. The first page of each language therefore does not carry the action. In Arabic the first page ends mid-hazard, at roughly 'سحب ركامية مصحوبة'. Fix: Rewrite both language versions so page 1 opens with the hazard in a few words followed by the action, for example 'Rain possible: avoid valley and flooded roads, drive carefully'. Move the area detail and times to later pages. Keep both versions under 15 pages. Do not extend the Arabic text more than needed, because it costs about 41 characters a page.

data.headline: Rain possible: avoid flooded roads and valleys, drive carefully
data.description: Rain possible: avoid flooded roads and valleys, drive carefully. NCM alert: convective clouds with light to moderate rain, heavy at times, in some eastern, southern and western areas and parts of the interior. Sat 22 Aug, 13:30 to 21:00.
data.instruction: Avoid valleys and flooded roads, and drive carefully. Follow updates at https://alerts.example.ae.
left_out: Nothing was left out because of verification. All inputs are verified.
data.note_for_reviewer: Per the network reviewer's objection, page 1 now opens with the hazard and action. The action wording (avoid valleys and flooded roads, drive carefully) comes from the reviewer's example, not from the NCM text. Only the English version is drafted here, so the Arabic version still needs the same reordering and its page-count check.
